cues.en:
Hello, come on in.
Thanks for coming.

This is the special development room
in my game company's lab.

GGF's "Battle Live-G" was
quite well received, thankfully.

Our president wants a version
we can roll out nationwide next.

So I'd like you to help
develop the new version.

Your job is the same.
Just keep playing as before.

You can keep using your machines
and parts as they are,

and we'll provide the runners you win in battle
free of charge.

Our goal is to measure,
for this battle system...

the limits of how far
players can handle it.

So the new missions are
far more difficult than before.
In a sense, no holding back.

But selected players like you
will surely enjoy it.

So I'd be glad if you started
playing again right away.
I've called the other selected players too.
You'll be able to play with them again.
